parts.name: Legend
parts.description: A list of the series of the chart. It makes a `<ul>` with one item per series.

props.name: children
props.type: Snippet<[{ name: string; index: number; symbol: ChartSymbol | undefined }]>
props.description:
The content of an item. It receives the name and the index of the series, and the shape of its
dots when a dot mark shows the series. Without it, an item shows a `data-swatch` element and
the name. For a series with a shape, the swatch holds an SVG of the shape.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the list.

dataAttributes.name: data-series
dataAttributes.description: On each item. The value is the name of the series.

dataAttributes.name: data-symbol
dataAttributes.description: On each item of a series with a shape. The value is the name of the shape.

dataAttributes.name: data-swatch
dataAttributes.description: On the element at the start of an item without children. It holds an SVG of the shape of a series with a shape.
